note: First-floor room of the bigger numbers and ordinals. The two masculine nouns (le million, le quart) are on the right (lion, pie man); the numbers and ordinal adjectives have no gender. The wooden staircase on the far left goes back down to the pronouns hall; the white door at the back right leads to the second pronouns room. Zoom: the long grey table at the back.
